info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get P2m By Authorization Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint provides access to detailed information about P2M transactions associated with a specific authorization ID. It allows users to seamlessly retrieve data related to payment processing, enhancing visibility and tracking capabilities. Typical consumers include developers integrating payment solutions and businesses needing transaction insights for compliance or reporting. The endpoint ensures quick lookup and retrieval of relevant P2M details to support operational and analytical needs.
